recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中大片脂肪空泡佔據整個顆粒，只有沿基質及空泡邊緣零星分布的造血細胞，顯示骨髓顆粒細胞量低（hypocellular）。
features: Low-power marrow particle dominated by large, empty fat vacuoles
Scattered small hematopoietic cells lining fat spaces and stromal strands
Dark-staining stromal condensations without cellular sheets
No clusters of large atypical cells or blasts evident at this power
Cytologic detail and dysplasia not assessable at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power shows a marrow particle largely replaced by adipocytes, with only scattered hematopoietic cells along stromal strands and at the edges of fat vacuoles, indicating decreased cellularity. Cytologic detail is insufficient at this magnification to evaluate dysplasia or blast percentage. Cellularity should be confirmed on core biopsy. With supportive dysplasia, blast count and cytogenetic findings, the features are consistent with hypocellular myelodysplastic syndrome.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia has equally fatty particles, so distinction relies on absent dysplasia and clonal cytogenetics, often supported by PNH clone and immune-mediated features.
Hypoplastic AML is also hypocellular but has at least 20% blasts on high-power count, which cannot be judged at this magnification.
Poorly sampled or subcortical aspirates may appear fatty, so a representative trephine biopsy is needed to confirm true hypocellularity.
